title: The Iron Regiment
author: I. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
